senses.gloss: m. (<he>דבך</he> = <cite ref="D00242"><he>דוך</he></cite>; v. Del. Prol., p. 150)

rammed wall (pisé), a mould filled with earth or rubble; a block of a certain size (four handbreadths cubic measure), or a course of bricks &c., used as ‘binder’ (coagmentum); in gen. a course of stones, layer.
units: Y. Shebi. III, 34ᶜ bot. זה שהוא מקבל נ׳ צריך וכ׳ he who contracts to build nidbakh, must build with blocks of four handbreadths as far as the space contracted for (v. infra).
<cite ref="Shabbat 115a:7">Sabb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר לבנאי שקעהו תחת הנ׳</he> he said to the builder, sink it (the translation of the Book of Job) under the rubble; Y. ib. XVI, 15ᶜ top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:4">Ber. II, 4</cite> mechanics at work may read the Sh’ma <he>בראש הנ׳</he> while standing on top of a course of the wall.
<cite ref="Shabbat 125b:7">Sabb. 125ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ של אבנים</he> a mouldful of stones (v. <cite ref="M02505"><he>מִרְבָּךְ</he></cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: a frame carried to the building ground with tools and vessels above and under it.
units: Tosef. Ohol. VII, 1 ארבעה שהיו נושאין את הנ׳ ואין וכ׳ if four persons carry a frame the poles of which have not the size of a plough-handle; Ohol. VI, 1 (ed. Dehr. נדוד; Ar. נרווד, read: נִדְוָךְ, נִדְוָוךְ; Maim. a bier).

<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 5:2">Zab. V, 2</cite> <he>אצבעו של זב תחת הנ׳</he> if the gonorrhœist has his finger under the frame (while it is carried).—Pl. <he>נִדְבָּכִין</he>, <he>נִדְבָּכוֹת</he>. Ohol. XIV, 1 <he>שלשה נ׳ וכ׳</he> a distance of three courses of stones which is twelve handbreadths; Tosef. ib. XIV, 8; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:4:4">Y. Shebi. III, 34ᵈ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:4:4">Ib.</cite> <he>שלשה נ׳ עשרה וכ׳</he> three courses of trimmed stones making ten handbreadths, v. <cite ref="O00866"><he>סִיתּוּת</he></cite>.
